residue.text: Source-bound alternative omitted from the selected six-trial construction: ATT proposes repeated fixed 300 rpm, 60-second trials without optical restart. Hypothesis: repeated sample success supports dispensability of the preferred dependency; failure does not establish that 900 rpm is necessary. These repetitions cannot be added to the selected three pairs within the session limit.

Source-bound omitted INV probes: fixed 300/900 rpm, 60-second comparisons and optional matched pauses at seconds 45–50, resuming until second 65. Hypothesis: agitation causes transient image disturbance. These require replacing selected trials; prompt image improvement cannot identify bubbles, establish pre-stop uniformity, or demonstrate a feedback loop.

Unequal quiet durations before second-120 sampling confound attribution to extra stirring. Record cessation times and all failures. Both failing, no duration separation, or mixed repeats leave the rival accounts unresolved; both passing with timer savings does not establish uniformity before stopping.

Matched 900 rpm final samples are absent. Specks may be bubbles, reflections or undissolved dye. Reference repeatability is not concentration calibration; nominal speed is unverified, sampling disturbs gradients, and six trials limit replication. Other recipes, scales and continuous processes remain untested.

summary.text: Observed synthetic anchor: one 300 rpm trial stopped at second 60 and yielded final attenuations 0.204, 0.209 and 0.207, approximately 2.4 percent spread. This bounds universal necessity of sustained 900 rpm, without establishing reliable sufficiency or why 900 rpm images fluctuate.

Rival hypotheses: A predicts timer and enabled-rule trials both meet the sample target, with timer savings despite failed shadow checks; unnecessary extensions may renew disturbances. B predicts timer failure and longer enabled-rule success because gradients require redistribution. Neither future is observed; the first causal divergence is allowing versus withholding optical commands after second 60.

Proposed construction: three fresh 900 rpm enabled-versus-timer pairs, reversing trial order across pairs. Timer stops at 60 regardless of images; enabled applies three successive five-second checks at most 4 percent and stops by 105. Fix 150 mL water, 0.30 mL dye, rinsed vessel, addition location, bottle, references and locked camera. Log shadow decisions, images, depression, specks and duration. Sample three depths at 120, alternating sampling order, and report raw readings and failures. Final-vial spread at most 4 percent is the bounded success proxy. Use spill tray; stop on escape.
